sens_en: to fall, to set, to leave behind
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi dit que les feuilles des arbres qui tombent se disent 落 : 艹, la plante, et 洛 pour le son. 洛, écrit 氵 et 各, se lit luò, exactement comme 落. Tomber, se coucher, rester en arrière.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi says that the falling of tree leaves is called 落: 艹, plant, with 洛 for the sound. 洛, written 氵 and 各, is read luò, exactly like 落. To fall, to set, to be left behind.
